ios.desc:
FluxCat is a complete AI creative studio in your pocket. Generate art from a
sentence, edit photos by describing the change, turn stills into moving video,
and train a private model that knows your face — all in one app, without a
desktop, a subscription to five services, or a single tutorial.

GENERATE ART FROM TEXT
Type what you imagine and watch it appear in seconds. Choose your aspect ratio
and output format, generate several versions at once, and save straight to your
camera roll. Fast drafts when you are exploring, photoreal detail when you have
found the shot.

EDIT PHOTOS BY DESCRIBING THE CHANGE
No layers, no brushes, no learning curve. Upload a photo and say what you want:
swap the background, change the outfit, remove the person in the corner,
restyle the whole thing as an oil painting. Blend several reference images into
one picture, or paint over the exact area you want redrawn and leave everything
else untouched.

BRING PHOTOS TO LIFE
The Video Studio animates a still image or builds a clip from a prompt alone.
Set the length, shoot widescreen for YouTube or vertical for Reels and TikTok,
render in HD, and pin the opening and closing frame so the motion lands exactly
where you want it. Some clips arrive with sound already on them.

TRAIN A MODEL OF YOU
Upload 10-20 photos of a face, a pet, a product or an art style and train your
own private model in about twenty minutes. Give it a trigger word and it stays
in your studio for good — put yourself in any era, any outfit, any place on
earth, and still look like you. Headshots, fantasy portraits, brand shots,
avatars: all of it from one training.

NEVER STARE AT A BLANK PROMPT BOX
Browse a searchable library of prompts shown with the images they produced, and
tap any one to reuse it. Build your own from categories — style, lighting,
camera, mood — with the Prompt Generator. Or hand the app a picture you like and
get back the prompt that describes it.

FINISH AND SHARE
- Upscale any result into a larger, sharper file
- Before and after slider, pinch to zoom on every image
- A private gallery on your device holding everything you have made
- One tap to Instagram, TikTok, Messages or Files
- Full resolution export with no watermark

quotes.text:
I've developed FluxAI, an AI art generator app for iOS that combines text-to-image generation with intelligent prompt assistance. Here's what it offers:

Key features:
• Smart Prompt Generator: AI refines user ideas into effective prompts
• Instant AI art generation from text
• Multiple artistic styles to choose from
• High-resolution output
• User-friendly interface for all skill levels
• Easy sharing to social media

I created FluxAI to address two main challenges in AI art creation:
1. Making advanced AI art tools accessible on mobile devices
2. Helping users formulate effective prompts to get better results

The Smart Prompt Generator is designed to bridge the gap between a user's initial concept and a well-crafted prompt that yields high-quality AI-generated art.

The app is free to use, with only a small number of premium features requiring an upgrade.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/fluxai/id6615076188

I'd love to hear the HN community's thoughts on:
1. The potential of AI-assisted creativity in various fields
2. Technical challenges in implementing AI art generation on mobile
3. Ethical considerations in AI-generated art

How do you see AI tools like this influencing the future of digital creativity?
